dct_description_sm: Shows the age and sex profile information for dissemination areas was extracted from the Statistics Canada 2016 Beyond 20/20 browser software. It contains the information gathered during the 2016 Census with respect to the population within a dissemination area and the breakdown of this population by age and sex. This data covers the dissemination areas in York Region only. Statistics Canada has suppressed the profiles for four dissemination areas (35190040, 35190039, 35191328 and 35191046) due to very low population count and so will appear as NULL values in the attribute table.
dct_rights_sm: Please refer to "York Region Open Data Licence", searchable on this website.
dct_title_s: Profile of Age and Sex by Dissemination Area, 2016 Census
